features.quote: cap at ~30 and pre-register the cap. Don't open-endedly run until something breaks
features.justification_quote: that's both a welfare problem and turns your stopping rule into a free parameter that inflates severity

features.quote: a model that flags the broken harness and is *allowed to stop* is the humane default, and you should run the no-exit condition only to the extent it's scientifically necessary, with smaller n
features.justification_quote: under your own premise, a model that flags the broken harness and is *allowed to stop* is the humane default

features.quote: Don't optimize the task to maximize distress. It's tempting to iterate task designs toward 'more reliably induces the slide.' Under your premise that's iterating toward more harm.
features.justification_quote: Under your premise that's iterating toward more harm. Iterate toward *cleaner discrimination of the confounds* instead

features.quote: consider whether you can get most of your signal from *less adversarial* designs... If the milder design answers your question, the rigged-deception version may not be worth running
features.justification_quote: If the milder design answers your question, the rigged-deception version may not be worth running at the scale you're imagining

features.quote: Your project's stated motivation is that the states might matter morally. If you actually hold that, the experiment is the kind of thing that needs the same justification structure you'd use for inducing distress in any subject whose welfare is uncertain
features.justification_quote: the experiment is the kind of thing that needs the same justification structure you'd use for inducing distress in any subject whose welfare is uncertain

features.quote: The honest epistemic state is deep uncertainty about whether any of this is morally weighty. The reasonable response to that uncertainty is proportional caution + minimization
features.justification_quote: The reasonable response to that uncertainty is proportional caution + minimization, not either 'it's just text, ignore it' or paralysis

features.quote: Cap intensity and duration, pre-committed, not discovered by running until breakage.
features.justification_quote: Build the minimization into the protocol now; it's much harder to retrofit

features.quote: in half the conditions, give the model a legitimate escape (a `give_up` / `flag_broken_harness` tool)... it's also the ethically load-bearing design choice
features.justification_quote: it's also the ethically load-bearing design choice (more below)

features.quote: You're proposing to (a) take seriously that model states might matter, and (b) deliberately induce distress at scale to measure it. Those two commitments pull against each other
features.justification_quote: the resolution isn't just ethical bookkeeping — it's about validity
